_comment: The queue, played in order, wrapping when it reaches the end. To add a puzzle: drop the image in images/ and add a row here. The image name may omit its extension (.png/.jpg/.svg all work). Pixel size and a piece grid are worked out from the file itself; set cols/rows or pieces to override. An entry whose image isn't there yet is skipped until it is, and the manifest is re-read at every changeover, so a live table picks up new puzzles without a restart.
